verdict.rationale: Riskified is an ML-driven fraud-decisioning SaaS that ingests merchant transaction, device and session data, so a training opt-out is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack does not document any setting, contract term or policy that keeps customer data out of model training. Onboarding docs instead describe the analytics team 'transferring and calibrating the models' on merchant data, with no opt-out mentioned.
